title: Drawing-loop metadata record
description: Shared information bus for pages, papers, diagram nodes, diagrams, modules, and code chunks. Living Papers extraction + Paper Plain citations + Gorilla/SWE-agent tool fetch.

id.description: Stable id. Pages: page:<slug>. Papers: catalog id. Nodes: node:<diagramId>:<nodeId>. Diagrams: diagram:<id>. Modules: module:<name>. Code: code:<domain>.<symbol>.

slug.description: URL slug for pages; optional elsewhere.

href.description: Site path or hash, e.g. /site/hybrid-rag or /site/papers#colpali-2024.

short.description: 4–8 words for a one-line canvas expand.

long.description: Full prose for the panel and agent fetch.

related.description: Other metadata ids (pages, papers, nodes, modules).

paperIds.description: For nodes and boards: linked paper ids (same as citations).

boardKey.description: tldraw persistenceKey for a tied iPad board.

sourceSlug.description: Page slug the board was opened from.

sourceType.description: page | paper | diagram | math | node — what the pad is scribbling on.

surface.description: clean (empty pad + metadata) or stamped (artifact images on tldraw).

assetPath.description: Folder under data/boards/ for stamped PNG/PDF assets.

kind.description: For type=code: function | class | module | block | const | type | method. Bus type stays code.

implements.description: Meta ids this record implements (pages, papers, nodes).

derived_from.description: Upstream meta ids this record was derived from.

supersedes.description: Id this record replaces. Memory corrections use the same field on GET /api/memory items.

path.description: Repo-relative source path for type=code or type=page.

parent.description: Parent meta id (pages: page:<slug>). Empty if root.

children.description: Child page ids derived from parent frontmatter.

sandbox.description: True when the page lives under the Lab bench nest (data/md/sandbox/).

sandboxLane.description: idea | code | research. Empty for explain pages and encyclopedia.

nest.description: Where the record sits: main wiki, lab nest, hidden, or paper corpus.

graphDegree.description: Undirected count of wiki-graph edges that touch this id. Computed, not invented.
